verdict.rationale: DPMA runs online search databases (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister) and e-filing tools, so a developer API reference is a fair question for this kind of service. However, the evidence pack documents no API, interactive reference, or runnable examples; it covers only web portals, desktop filing software, and paper filing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
